synopsis: A comedy about dumping dead bodies for the Prime Minister.

films.title: Forced Parenthood
synopsis: The Republicans are on the verge of eliminating abortion rights, but don’t worry, they’ve got a plan!

films.title: Catarina
credits: Co-producers – Olivier Berlemont, Emilie Dubois & Emmanuel Gétaz
synopsis: Ruined and left by his wife, Francis is ready to try everything he can. With the help of his friend Simon, he decides to kidnap the wife of the man who conned him, Alex. That guy is crazy about Catarina and keeps saying he would do anything for her.
The duo of good-for-nothings somehow manages to kidnap the young woman.
The problem is, Catarina is actually a Maltese dog, and they just kidnapped Marie, the dogsitter.

films.title: Two Hitmen
credits: Directors & Producers – Chris Kibble & Aurora Sice
Cast – Mark Samuel, Alassane Kane & Matthew Priestley
synopsis: This is a comedy short film about two hitmen who continually misunderstand their assignment.

films.title: The Krewd Party
credits: Co-producers – Bambi Valentine, Yanni Pounartzis & Alice Taylor
synopsis: STRAIGHT OUTTA CANBERRA! A single mother of 8 living in the govie flats of Canberra, MC KREWD is a hip hop artist, a philosopher, and a defender of outcasts. When a documentary crew film MC KREWD hosting a BBQ for her neighbours, she reveals an opportunistic plan to get her voice heard.

films.title: Titanic On A Plane
credits: Director, Writer, Producer & Cast – Ross Ozarka
synopsis: What if James Cameron’s Titanic was rebooted, and the ship was changed to be a plane? The answer: something really, really dark.

films.title: Glen
credits: Writer – Duncan Ragg, Jessica Marshall, Peter Dabro
synopsis: Deep into his first lockdown, 50-year-old Glen is given a second chance at love… but only if he can summon the courage to come face to Facebook with the perils of online seduction.

films.title: Sneeze
credits: Cast – Solveig Bjerre Pettersen & Pål André Holdahl
synopsis: While on a date, a man holds a sneeze back, and the woman gets scared his head will explode.

films.title: Poul (The Bridge)
credits: Writer – Vahid Hassan Zadeh & Maryam Esmikhani
synopsis: Fired, a young girl on a bridge looks over. An old guy berates her for considering throwing herself over. Life does not look good. Then there is this young fella who has a shit job & a motorcycle…

films.title: Broccoli
credits: Cast – Nelson Scott, Samantha Lee, Alexander Spinks
synopsis: It’s dinner time, and Blade won’t eat his broccoli. His mum decides to tell him a cautionary tale from her childhood about the time she lost a hand to her father for not eating her own broccoli. Within this story, her father tells another cautionary tale about how he lost his leg to his mother for not eating his broccoli and she tells a similar tale which continues into another and another and another ending with the bizarre genesis of this violent family tradition.

films.title: There Is Someone At Home
